Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgBiotin 30μgVitamin A 700μgVitamin B1 0.7mgVitamin B2 0.9mgVitamin B6 0.9mgVitamin D 10μgVitamin E 11mgVitamin K 70μgSelenium 35μgZinc 8.5mgOnce a day

온가족 멀티비타민 꾸미젤리 키즈 앤 패밀리Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc

Made by (주)알피바이오 · Once a day · 1 gummy

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 30μg of Biotin, 700μg of Vitamin A, 0.7mg of Vitamin B1, 0.9mg of Vitamin B2, 0.9mg of Vitamin B6, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 70μg of Vitamin K, 35μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 gummy): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 0.7mg Vitamin B1, 0.9mg Vitamin B2, 0.9mg Vitamin B6, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 70μg Vitamin K, 35μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 gummy per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 1.9g), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 1.9g), 80~180%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 1.9g), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.7mg / 1.9g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.9mg / 1.9g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.9mg / 1.9g), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 1.9g), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 1.9g), 80~150%
Vitamin K labelled (70μg / 1.9g), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (35μg / 1.9g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 1.9g), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 주황색 점박이가 있는 빨간색의 원형 젤리
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18개월
Storage 1) 제품은 고온에 약하니 직사광선을 피하여 실온(25도 이하 권장), 습도가 낮은 곳에서 보관·소비해주십시오.2) 유통 및 소비 중 변질되지 않도록 포장의 파손 등에 주의하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Vitamin K

    • Needed for the structure of bone

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 gummy): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 0.36mg Vitamin B1, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 70μg Vitamin K, 16.5μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

이뮨츄Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc

Made by (주)알피바이오 · Once a day · 1 gummy

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 30μg of Biotin, 700μg of Vitamin A, 0.36mg of Vitamin B1, 0.42mg of Vitamin B2, 0.45mg of Vitamin B6, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 70μg of Vitamin K, 16.5μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 gummy): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 0.36mg Vitamin B1, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 70μg Vitamin K, 16.5μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc together daily

Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
